notes.title: May 2025 Small Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Trees should no longer obstruct your view of the catapults strength and angle stats
[*] Small UI improvement in Single Player Mode
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access - Version 0.3.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Completely revamped the solo mode[/h1]
[h2]Solo mode[/h2]
[list]
[*]The closer your predictions, the stronger the next launch
[*]Climbing the leaderboard now relies less on luck and more on skill!
[/list]
[h1]Added French language support[/h1]
[list]
[*]Oui, oui!
[*]Some translations are still in the work
[/list]
[h2]Implemented small fixes and improvements[/h2]

notes.title: Early Access - Version 0.2.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Improvement[/h2]
[list]
[*]Better map generation
[*]Increased the width of the road in the Car Crash mode
  - This change is made to prevent the player from always going into the trees
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Addressed an issue that prevented the leaderboard from displaying properly
[*]Addressed an issue where trees would spawn in mid-air
[*]Addressed an issue where characters were able to go beneath the map by surpassing boundaries
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access - Version 0.2.1
notes.notes:
[h2]New Character[/h2]
[h3]The Blue Character[/h3]
[list]

[/list]
[h2]Car Speedometer added[/h2]
[list]
[*] In the "Car Crash" game mode, you can now see the speed of the car on the top right corner
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access - Version 0.1.1
notes.notes:
[h3]-You can now move the first person camera to look around[/h3]
  The first person camera is still mainly driven by the ragdoll
[h3]-Game now shows the Streamer name before each matches[/h3]
  If you mistyped your channel name, you will see it right away
[h3]-Bug fixes[/h3]
